description: Approve a pull request: records an 'approved' review by the caller — the same review the web form and POST /api/v2/repos/:owner/:repo/pulls/:number/reviews write, so it counts toward branch protection's required approvals and clears the caller's own earlier request for changes. The PR must be open; its author cannot approve it. Requires write access and 'repo' scope. To request changes use gluecron_request_changes. Returns {reviewId, number, state, url}.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_approve_pr
